scene: The rusty hatch squeals open to reveal a ladder down.
picture: Rooftop tiles run along the ground line. On the far left sits a shiny chrome wrench. Left of centre, an open rusty hatch reveals a metal ladder leading down. In the centre stands the tall mustachioed man in his red poncho, straw hat, and guitar. On the far right, a pigeon sits on a chimney.

a shiny chrome wrench lying on the tiles, far left
